description: Reverse ownership: which funds AND institutional 13F managers hold a given security. Accepts a CUSIP, ISIN, FIGI, or ticker. entityType distinguishes fund from manager.

as_of.description: Point-in-time date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the latest snapshot on or before this date. Omit for the most recent.

available_as_of.description: Lookahead guard (YYYY-MM-DD): only consider filings actually published by this date. Use for backtests.

identifier.description: Security CUSIP, ISIN, FIGI, or ticker (e.g. AAPL).

name: who_holds
